'''June 2001 Rancho Cucamonga tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rancho Cucamonga, California on 15 June 2001. [[Nick LaFarga]] won it. It is known from Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2496">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-21-longshot-in-rancho-ca-6-15-01d2496/ longshot-in-rancho-ca-6-15-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 21 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-21-longshot-in-rancho-ca-6-15-01d2496/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Rancho Cucamonga, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Nick LaFarga]]
